title: Emits a foul burned plastic odor every use
text:
Emits a foul burned plastic odor every use. We have a similar, different brand mini fireplace heater that is awesome. I wanted this one for a different space to take the chill off. This one is the same size as our good one, but puts out far less heat. The vents on tops are narrower and shorter which means the heat is limited.

Additionally, after two days and a couple of hours total use, the foul, plastic burning smell/fumes is still there and it hasn't dissipated. That odor happens with most space heaters the first time they are used, but will normally go away quickly. Because of the low heat and foul odor, I dont feel safe using this.
